target_customer: Local businesses buying ads shown to rideshare passengers
problem: Advertisers lacked a way to reach captive riders with interactive, actionable offers inside Uber and Lyft cars.
business_model: Advertising revenue from businesses on in-car tablets, later a gift card platform for small businesses

founders.name: Nader Khalil
founders.background_notes: CEO title from a CB Insights snippet; YC page lists no bio.

competitors.name: Octopus Interactive
competitors.what: Interactive tablets and ads inside Uber and Lyft rides
competitors.traction_then: Claimed 3 million monthly reach from 10,000 in-taxi screens

competitors.name: Firefly
competitors.what: Rooftop and in-car digital ads on rideshare vehicles that pay drivers

technical_complexity.rationale: Needed Android tablets in cars, ad serving, offline sync and ride re-routing integration, some of it hardware logistics for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Rivals with far more funding offered the same screens, and Uber and Lyft controlled the platform access.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Lyft consolidated advertising into Lyft Media per a search summary; no direct action against Paneau is documented.

market_need_then: Rideshare volume was large in 2019 and several funded startups targeted in-car ads, which signals advertiser interest, but Paneau specific demand data was not found.

brand_strength.rationale: Only directory listings; a name-focused search returned nothing about the company.

pivots.to: Gift card platform for small and medium businesses
pivots.why: COVID-19 cut ad budgets and ride volume, per a San Diego Business Journal report

outcome_analysis: Paneau sold in-car ads in a segment crowded with better funded rivals, and COVID-19 collapsed rideshare volume and ad budgets in spring 2020. By May 2020 it was pivoting to a gift card platform for small businesses, and the YC directory now lists it Inactive. Whether the pivot failed or the company simply stopped is not documented publicly, so pivot_failed is an inference from the status.
notes: paneau.io did not resolve from this session. The 150K seed rests on CB Insights, consistent with the standard YC deal. Founding year 2018 is from CB Insights and Village.ai. The SDBJ article was seen only as a search summary, not opened. Alec Fong and Nader Khalil roles are from the YC page.
